global: This is miso ramen, its rich, amber broth glistening. Topped with chashu pork, menma, and a halved soft-boiled egg, garnished with green onions. Served in a white bowl with black characters, resting on an orange tray under bright, even light.

regions.background: Orange tray with smooth, slightly textured surface, rectangular shape with rounded corners visible.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with black Japanese characters, smooth glossy surface, slightly raised rim.
regions.soup: The miso broth is rich amber, glossy, and thick, cradling noodles and green onions in a swirling, textured surface.
regions.cut_egg: A halved boiled egg shows a runny, golden yolk surrounded by creamy white, with a smooth, slightly glossy surface.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice shows marbled texture with translucent fat, browned edges, and glossy surface from broth.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, slightly translucent, with a smooth surface and curved, elongated shape.
